description: Round-trip supported queries through SQL; reject verification defects and preserve native expectations

skip_tests.reason: The generated SQL changes the query pipelines whose tasks the fixture counts
A second binding pass adds transaction or file-operation log events
Reoptimization changes stats() observations and physical scan profiling; these fixtures assert the original plan
A volatile collated subquery group is grouped differently once its GROUP BY ALL is expanded to SQL
Native join reordering or implied filters change whether casts on excluded rows are evaluated
The fixture expects a particular row order without ORDER BY; rebinding may choose another valid order
The extension injects an internal rowid_filter without a SQL catalog entry; it has no rebindable SQL representation
PARQUET_VARIANT is an internal type alias that is not registered for SQL type lookup
Generated SQL exposes a native IEJoin payload type mismatch with debug_verification_projection, reproducible with SQL export disabled
The native progress stress fixture folds range(500000) into a list; reconstructing and rebinding its 500000 SQL literals exceeds the configuration budget
Reconstructed expressions have locations in generated SQL rather than the original source; the fixture requires original-source error carets
The internal EXPLAIN exceeds the 300 KiB limit; the fixture deliberately distinguishes SELECT from EXPLAIN allocations
Statement verification temporarily disables profiling for its internal EXPLAIN, changing current_setting observations
The fixture imposes a 30 second execution deadline that the additional planning and rebinding pass exceeds
